purpose: U5.1: render a 3-frame scene on at least 3 GPU models
gpu_models_note: Minimum is 3 distinct models; add a CPU-only run (device=CPU). A HIP run needs a ROCm-based image and is not part of wave 1.

checks.expect: container exit code 0 and output.json ok=true
each frame has pixel standard deviation > 5
when device=AUTO on a GPU host, log shows OPTIX or CUDA device selected (not silent CPU fallback)
frames from different GPU models pass the kit's perceptual verification against each other
kill after frame 2, rerun with COMPUTECOIN_RESUME=1 and the checkpoint dir: frames 1-2 are not re-rendered, output identical
a scene with a driver/script that writes /out/pwned is rendered without creating that file
